_comment: Task 1.11: unmapped stars (D11, about 40). Seen at long range, never charted, no known lanes; drawn dimmer. Named after the Calder probe catalog except the notable few. Positions are absolute (light-years), inside the 25 ly sphere and at least 2.5 ly from any region center.
